thesis: The page is a desert pool almanac: every section is a month spread with a folio number and a thumb-index tab on the right edge, and the signature is the tab that slides out and lights up as you read through the year.

signature.name: Almanac Thumb-Index
signature.summary: Vertical strip of month abbreviations pinned right (horizontal pill row on mobile); each section activates its tab via --sw-active custom property set by IntersectionObserver. Tab slides out 8px and fills with accent on entry. Reused in hero masthead, four season spreads, review month pills, and footer reset. Hook: data-sw-signature='almanac-tab'.

palette.family: Sonora Sand + Pool Teal + Terracotta Signal

motion.intro: Cover photo settles from 1.03→1.0 scale; cover lines slide in from right with 80ms stagger; current month tab pulses once. ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Thumb-index tab slides out 8px and fills with accent color on section entry (ease-out 400ms)
Folio number counts up from previous spread via requestAnimationFrame (600ms)
motion.hover: 2px terracotta underline grows from left (scaleX 0→1, 200ms ease-out) on links and buttons
